decision: Expand the still-unreleased V2.0 shipping scope to include the OFU-owned hierarchical multiscale Deep3D RenderScene/RenderPacket architecture with a preferred WebGPU backend and a complete WebGL2 direct-file/offline backend.
supersedesForCurrentUnreleasedV2Only: DEFERRED_POST_V2_0 dispositions for shipping-eligible Deep3D/WebGPU rendering work
authorityBoundary: Renderer consumes canonical/model/presentation-authorized state and never becomes scientific, simulation, identity, persistence or history authority.
